proof_body:
by
  intro f a x hf
  have heq : (fun y => ∫ t in a..y, (y - t) * f t) = fun y => y * (∫ t in a..y, f t) - ∫ t in a..y, t * f t := by
    ext y
    have h1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => y * f t) MeasureTheory.volume a y := (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t => y * f t).intervalIntegrable a y
    have h2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => t * f t) MeasureTheory.volume a y := (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t => t * f t).intervalIntegrable a y
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h1 h2]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun t _ => ?_
    ring
  rw [heq]
  have hF : HasDerivAt (fun y => ∫ t in a..y, f t) (f x) x := (hf.integral_hasStrictDerivAt a x).hasDerivAt
  have hG : HasDerivAt (fun y => ∫ t in a..y, t * f t) (x * f x) x :=
    ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun t => t * f t).integral_hasStrictDerivAt a x).hasDerivAt
  exact (((hasDerivAt_id' x).fun_mul hF).fun_sub hG).congr_deriv (by ring)
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a x : ℝ), Continuous f → HasDerivAt (fun y => ∫ t in a..y, (y - t) * f t) (∫ t in a..x, f t) x
